mechanism_narrative: The monotonic recovery of WORKPLACES from -51.7 to -20.6 over three weeks restores weekday commuting routines and office-adjacent footfall, which mechanically lifts RETAIL_REC over the following four weeks relative to its -16.0 trough level.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is at or below -16.0 despite WORKPLACES continuing to move toward baseline.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has crossed above the -45 percent threshold in the latest week (-43.6 after -50.3), a sign that containment rules have been eased enough to permit discretionary trips; within one week this releases pent-up shopping demand and lifts RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean rises above -45 percent from a level below -48 percent
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC in week t+1 falls below the -16.0 level of week t-0 following the TRANSIT crossing above -45.

failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL below +10 and WORKPLACES recovery above 20 points co-occur with RETAIL_REC flat or lower over the next 14 days.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days rises above its last-14-day mean in weeks where PARKS week-on-week change exceeds 10 points.
